requirements.finding: No target-specific evidence proves secret pages are excluded from swap or hibernation images.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Document and test OS-specific memory-locking and hibernation policy for every supported target.

requirements.finding: The prototype does not verify that crash artifacts exclude process memory and secret buffers.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Disable or sanitize core dumps and crash collection, then exercise a crashing negative control.

requirements.finding: Source-level zeroization does not prove allocator pages are not copied, cached, or reused before erasure.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Measure target allocator behavior and retain a negative control with zeroization removed.

requirements.finding: No application integration trace establishes that plaintext or keys never enter temporary files.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Trace filesystem writes across success, failure, export, and crash paths.

requirements.finding: No production logging boundary has been exercised against secret-bearing error paths.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Run structured-log and telemetry leakage tests with seeded canary secrets.

requirements.finding: The prototype does not define how local backups, VM snapshots, or filesystem snapshots treat unlocked state.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Specify and test backup/snapshot policy per deployment target.

requirements.finding: No host policy currently constrains debuggers, same-user processes, memory inspection, or privileged tooling.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Define the local attacker boundary and verify target process-hardening controls.

requirements.finding: No lifecycle integration test proves secrets and plaintext projections are removed on lock, logout, shutdown, or restart.
requirements.enforcement_requirement: Exercise all lifecycle transitions with seeded canaries and durable post-restart scans.
